description:
The domains AI models cite most across ALL workspaces in the organization. Aggregate view for multi-workspace orgs.

Use when the user wants org-level source analysis -- phrases like 'across all workspaces', 'org-wide sources', 'top domains overall', or 'which sites dominate'. For one workspace, use get_citation_sources.

Example: 'Which domains are cited most across all our brands?'

days.description: How many days back to look, counted back from end_date (default today). Default 30, max 90. Ignored when start_date is given. Prompts are re-run on a schedule, so a window shorter than a week can be empty.
days.title: Days

domain_limit.description: How many domains to list. Default 15, max 50.
domain_limit.title: Domain Limit

end_date.description: Optional end of the window, as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default today. Cannot be in the future.
end_date.title: End Date

start_date.description: Optional explicit start of the window, as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). A full ISO datetime is accepted and its date is used. Overrides days.
start_date.title: Start Date

name: get_top_cited_domains
title: Top cited domains, all workspaces
